Create a post-project feedback survey for my [type of service] clients. 
I want to learn: (1) How satisfied they were overall, (2) What specifically went well, (3) What could be improved, (4) Whether they'd refer me, (5) If there's anything else they need. Write 10 questions — mix of rating scale (1-5), multiple choice, and open-ended. Keep it completable in under 3 minutes. The tone should make clients feel like their feedback genuinely matters, not like a corporate survey. Include a brief intro message and a thank-you closing.
